title: Archive: write the name on it
subtitle: The last filing
intro: Put the things she said into the envelope. Open your hand and let them fall in.
closing: The file closes. The name is still there.
name: Sakurazaki Ayaka

cards.text: You're not useless. You're Pharmacist Bocchi, and you saved me.
I've made up my mind to take my meds properly and never od again.
Bocchi, is it still in time for me to turn back?
I won't die, I won't die, I won't die...
